title: (Yonhap Interview) More productive, attractive regions outside Seoul key to sustaining growth: OECD officials
caption:
The OECD identifies a critical challenge for South Korea: maintaining economic growth amidst a shrinking population. Experts suggest moving beyond corporate incentives to focus on regional quality of life.

Source: En - (Yonhap Interview) More productive, attractive regions outside Seoul key to sustaining growth: OECD officials
